title: Arithmetic Operators
description: Demonstrate the basic arithmetic operators on two numbers.
code:
a = 17
b = 5

print("Sum:", a + b)
print("Difference:", a - b)
print("Product:", a * b)
print("Division:", a / b)
print("Floor Division:", a // b)
print("Modulus:", a % b)
print("Power:", a ** b)
expectedOutput:
Sum: 22
Difference: 12
Product: 85
Division: 3.4
Floor Division: 3
Modulus: 2
Power: 1419857
